headline: The Latch Returns to Warden Hands as Callahan's Passage Rages
war_summary: Since our last edition the furnace at Callahan's Passage has burned fiercer still: The Latch, carried by the Colonials only hours ago, has swung back to the Warden flag, leaving ten Warden works against none on that front, with day's losses near sixteen thousand and the hourly toll still climbing as we go to press. Weathered Expanse remains the busiest ground in the war, fifty-five actions in the day about Wightwalk and Frostmarch, the latest logged at the filing hour, its ledger dead even at four works apiece with one in ruins. Fisherman's Row's demolished work has been reoccupied, eight Warden holdings and one Colonial standing there now, while Godcrofts, quiet in our last report, has stirred anew: twenty-eight actions in the day, six inside two hours, Isawa and The Axehead the busiest posts. Linn of Mercy bleeds on without a flag moving since mid-morning about The First Coin; Blackthroat in the Viper Pit and Mox in Marban Hollow endure their poundings; Breaker Town and The Pale House keep up their duel on Stlican Shelf. The Dead Lands stay silent. The ledger now reads 280 works Colonial, 153 Warden, three in ruins, a net gain of two to the Wardens since last reported. It is day 188; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is named.
